accounting: Daily realized returns divided by prior realized equity, all 932 sessions, sample standard deviation, sqrt(252), zero risk-free rate. Maximum drawdown uses closed-trade equity; the chart displays daily closing equity.
cost_note: Bid/ask costs are modeled. Commissions, exchange fees, added slippage and market impact are not included.
execution_basis: Spreads retain their original executable quote model; EX buys at the archived ask and exits at the archived bid. Historical EX execution does not reproduce sub-minute production quote polling, pending-entry retries or actual broker fills.
input_policy: Component coverage differs. Spread research covers 929 of 932 sessions through September 22, 2026; the original EX cohort covers 607 of 836 sessions through May 5, 2026. EX outcomes on the other 325 dates are unknown, not known-zero trades. Missing inputs are not synthesized.
limitations: This conditional research curve uses unequal component coverage and historically selected rules. It is not independent confirmation or a full-data replay of the live bot. EX increases gross P&L under compounding, but lowers win rate, PF and Daily Sharpe and deepens drawdown versus the spread-only control. The original one-contract EX total was negative in 2025; the normalized result does not establish stable sleeve expectancy. The pilot samples remain only 9 and 11 original trades; one commissioned sleeve retains low-confidence research evidence. Quote depth, broker capacity and fill impact are not modeled at larger simulated sizes. Historical results do not guarantee future performance.
provenance: Earlier six-spread research contained 263 trades and +$22,332 under its original canonical sizing convention. The same-engine normalized spread-only counterfactual reproduces every quantity and P&L exactly. These remain separate research records even though their results match.
scope: This historical research replay combines six defined-risk intraday credit-spread setups with four directional Extrinsic (EX) sleeves: two commissioned sleeves and two live pilots. It uses frozen historical research rules and modeled executable option quotes.
sizing_basis: CURRENT-RULE ALLOCATIONS APPLIED RETROSPECTIVELY: starting modeled equity $10,000, no deposits, gross realized-equity compounding, whole-contract sizing and a shared 15% contractual-exposure ceiling. Commissioned EX sleeves use 15%; pilots 3.75%. EX changes subsequent equity and spread quantities; the controlled comparison below separates direct EX P&L from that portfolio effect.
vintage_note: EX retains the original certified archive availability and exclusions; a later expanded archive is a different research cohort.
